description.message: Replaces the start page of private windows with the plain truth about what a private window hides and what it does not.

p_lead.message: It keeps this computer from remembering what you do here. ==It does not make you invisible.==

p_y1.message: Forgets history, cookies, form entries and cached files when you close the window.

p_y2.message: Keeps what you do here apart from your normal windows.

p_y3.message: Klin's protections stay on: trackers blocked, fingerprints reduced.

p_n1.message: **Your internet provider**, and the owner of the Wi-Fi network (home, work, school, café): they still see which sites you contact.

p_n2.message: **The sites you visit**: they see your IP address, and what you do on them.

p_n3.message: **Your accounts**: once you log in, the site knows who you are.

p_n4.message: **What you download or bookmark**: it stays on this computer.

p_next.message: To see what a site can read about you, open it and click **What can this site see?** in the toolbar.
